build.title: Drag and snap banner and toolbar widgets (no overlaps)

said.text: Widgets attached to banners and toolbars (clock, axHub badge, Claude badge, plugin widgets) overlap. Arrange mode: drag a widget, it snaps between the others on a side; arrangement saved per host as a look setting (axf.widgets.arrange.<host>), hot render. Web only.

steps.text: Engine: arrangement layer + snap/move helpers in widgets.ts, fixtures
Runtime: arrangement setting, move/reset, arrange mode + actions
React: drag + snap on banner and toolbar, context menu
CSS: no overlap on banner sides; drop marker
